articles.title: Disney President Reacts to Live-Action Moana Flop, Says It Was an 'Excellent Film' Hit by 'Unusual Circumstances'
articles.summary: Disney president Dana Walden has blamed "unusual circumstances" for the live-action Moana movie's disappointing box office, and defended the project as an otherwise "excellent film." Speaking this week at the Bloomberg Screentime event (via Variety ), Walden framed Moana's poor performance as a…
body: "It's so competitive right now that you have to have... the right film at the right time, with audiences feeling a certain degree of demand," Walden stated. "I would say our live-action Moana, which is excellent, I think it was hurt by the proximity to our second animated version of Moana, which came together under unusual circumstances, but premiered about 18 months before this one."

The unusual circumstances Walden is referring to here relate to Disney's relatively last-minute pivot that saw Moana 2 change from launching as a Disney+ series to a theatrical movie. This resulted in the project being slotted into Disney's film schedule awkwardly just a year and a half before the long-gestating plans for a live-action film.
"Perhaps there was not enough time to create a lot of pent-up demand for another film," Walden concluded.

articles.title: Avengers: Secret Wars Filming Delay Reports Spark Concern That Marvel's Multiverse Saga Finale May Be Postponed
articles.summary: Reports of an Avengers: Secret Wars filming delay have sparked concern among Marvel fans that the movie's release date could be pushed back. This week, an array of Marvel movie insiders reported hearing that filming on Marvel's big Multiverse Saga finale will now begin later than planned, after…
body: Serial MCU tipsters Daniel Richtman, Alex Perez, and Apocalyptic Horseman appear to have independently verified that Secret Wars shooting will now take place early in 2027, likely in January, sparking concern among fans about the impact this hold up will potentially have.

It's worth making clear that Marvel is yet to give any official update on its production schedule, and it ultimately may not need to do so if there's no impact on Secret Wars' planned December 17, 2027 launch date. That said, the potential of the movie's shooting schedule changing has many fans questioning if the film can still be completed in time.

"Gives the cast time to promote Doomsday during this winter," Marvel fan BTSMGL wrote in one of several lengthy threads on reddit. "I'm not in a rush for Ghost Rider so as long as we get X-Men and BP3 still in 2028, I'm fine with this."

"A *lot* is riding on Doomsday," added vadermaulkylo. "They’re probably waiting to see how it's received before committing to anything. If Doomsday gets a bad critical and/or audience reception then that'll drastically change what they'd do in its second act film."

articles.title: GTA 6 Rating Officially Confirms Sex Will Indeed Be in the Game
articles.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 is officially rated M for Mature, which isn't surprising at all — these games are all about playing a criminal, after all. However, it seems that players will be doing a lot more than committing crimes; there are actual sex scenes in-game that have been deemed worthy of a warning…
body: PlayStation and Xbox have added age ratings to GTA 6 's store pages across several regions. This gives us some idea of what to expect from the game's more extreme content. Alongside its Mature rating in the United States, there were the following warning labels: blood and gore, intense violence, mature humor, nudity, strong language, strong sexual content, and use of drugs and alcohol.

These are the same labels seen on Grand Theft Auto 5 's store page, so it wasn't particularly alarming. However, fans in New Zealand and Australia noticed a label GTA 6 didn't share with its predecessor. While both are rated R18+, GTA 5 's warnings list "sexual material" and GTA 6 lists "sex scenes," indicating a difference between the two.

articles.title: Justin Wong and IFC Yipes Literally Commentate Ryu's Match Against Blanka in the Street Fighter Movie
articles.summary: We already knew about Justin Wong and IFC Yipes’ cameo in the upcoming Street Fighter movie, but it looks like they got to put their commentary skills to work for the part, too.
body: Director Kitao Sakurai made sure the fighting game community felt represented in his Street Fighter film, inviting Justin Wong, IFC Yipes, and Maximilian Dood to play criminals in an apparent Shadaloo prison while Blanka (Jason Momoa) and Ryu (Andrew Koji) duke it out for M. Bison’s viewing pleasure.

These three community pillars were shown in a short teaser for the movie back in July. Come October 1, Wong shared some behind-the-scenes footage of his time on set, which included a closer look at the scene he shared with Yipes.

Previously, we only saw the two fighting game pros-turned-commentators going bananas for Blanka and Ryu’s brawl; Wong’s footage shows himself and Yipes literally commentating the match, betting on commissary rations like ramen noodles and toilet paper.

All of the guest influencers got a tour of a few of the film’s sets, which included a look at some of the movie’s props. One of those props appeared to be Mike Haggar’s pipe, which would be an insane reference to include but not totally unexpected, given that Final Fight and Street Fighter take place in the same universe.

articles.title: Person Behind Viral AI-Generated Fallout: New York Game Hauls It Offline, Says Bethesda Issued Cease and Desist
articles.summary: The person behind a viral AI-generated Fallout: New York game has pulled it offline after receiving a cease and desist from Bethesda.
body: Earlier this week, a self-styled “AI creative” known as “CHRIS FIRST” on X / Twitter published a video of Fallout: New York, a game built by Claude Opus 5.5 and made playable in a browser. It included quests, companions, dialogue trees, Fallout’s iconic V.A.T.S. combat and even a working Pip-Boy.

The initial video, viewed 3.5 million times on X / Twitter, sparked a debate about the rights and wrongs of CHRIS FIRST’s use of AI, with some calling the game AI slop, and others impressed by the gameplay. As you’d expect, many responded to the video to predict that Bethesda would eventually step in, although CHRIS FIRST seemed somewhat naive to the situation.

“It’s all free and I make 0 money on it,” he tweeted. “I hope they don’t ask me to take it down. I really love Fallout and this was just a fun tech demo. But I should add a quest where you have to serve someone papers, but they keep running away.”
points: The person behind a viral AI-generated Fallout: New York game has pulled it offline after receiving a cease and desist from Bethesda.

articles.title: PS5 gets "AI-guided upscaling" a bit like PS5 Pro's, and it's available now in Marvel's Wolverine and Ghost of Yotei
articles.summary: AI image upscaling is coming to PlayStation 5, Sony has announced, and it's available already in two games: Marvel's Wolverine and Ghost of Yotei.
body: The image-upscaling technology is called Quick Spectral Super Resolution (QSSR), and it's positioned as a slightly diluted or lesser version of the PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR), which is available on PS5 Pro - the "gold standard" of "AI-guided upscaling", Sony said on the PlayStation blog.

QSSR apparently provides improvements to image detail and "stability", courtesy of "a hand-tuned implementation that maximizes performance on PS5". In a comparison video for Marvel's Wolverine, the close-up image appeared fairly clear - detail is noticeably crisper with QSSR on.

"QSSR adds more pixel-level clarity and stability to our environments," Insomniac head of tech Mike Fitzgerald commented, "bringing out extra detail amidst the busy streets of Madripoor, the dense alleyways of Shinjuku, and many other areas across Logan's epic journey." It apparently "brings a great taste of the PS5 Pro experience" to players on PS5.
points: AI image upscaling is coming to PlayStation 5, Sony has announced, and it's available already in two games: Marvel's Wolverine and Ghost of Yotei.

articles.title: 31 Years Later, the Definitive Sci-Fi Cyberpunk Movie Is Free to Stream on YouTube
articles.summary: Anime has never been short on landmark science fiction. Akira wrote the book on bridging cyberpunk and adult animation, while Neon Genesis Evangelion blended apocalyptic mech battles and psychological trauma into pure spectacle.
body: Yet for all the incredible science fiction anime the industry has produced, none has stared so directly into the unsettling future of synthetic identity and digital consciousness quite like Ghost in the Shell. Mamoru Oshii’s 1995 classic remains one of anime’s crowning achievements, influencing everything from 1999’s The Matrix to 2009’s Avatar, and there’s no better time to confront its bleak technological future than now, while it’s free to watch on YouTube.

Akin to some of my favorite shows — like Sonny Boy, Serial Experiments Lain, and Cowboy Bebop — Ghost in the Shell doesn't rely on high-octane action. Oshii lets audiences sit in silence more often than spectacle, letting you digest the on-screen outcomes and face some very dark perspectives on the nature of technology in an ever-evolving world. The director fills those moments with a smattering of neo-noir cyberpunk imagery, like crowded city streets, towering mega-buildings, neon-lit signs, rain-slicked windows, tangled wires dangling precariously overhead, floating carrier-filled skylines, and boats moving through polluted waterways.

articles.title: Buffy Meets Hannibal In the Cult Classic Detective Series Streaming Free on YouTube
articles.summary: Before the streaming era, fans of sci-fi, horror, and fantasy stories had to settle for what was closest. In that time, The CW became an important channel for many, especially a generation of viewers who wanted to enjoy the traditional trappings of teen romance and drama with higher stakes, be that…
body: Even if you only discovered them years later on Netflix or Hulu, you're probably familiar with classic examples like The Vampire Diaries and The 100. However, one of the best examples of The CW era ran for five seasons, yet never found a wider audience, remaining one of the channel’s best-kept secrets. Until now.

iZombie premiered in 2015, making it one of the last proper CW shows. The series follows a zombie woman trying to lead a meaningful life as she juggles work, relationships, and a craving for brains. As of Aug. 1, the entire series is streaming for free on YouTube, making this the perfect opportunity for you to dive into its world and fall in love with all of its strangeness.

McIver is a great performer, delivering the right amount of humor and detachment that’s needed to make her sweet yet sometimes deadly zombie work. Through the episodes, she gravitates between a well-rounded cast of supporting characters, including her boss Ravi (Rahul Kohli), a morbidly curious zombie ally on the hunt for a cure; and her detective partner Clive (Malcolm Goodwin), who’s consistently puzzled by her unexplainable intuition, yet always comes back because she makes his job so much easier.

articles.title: Turns out you can download more battery as Valve's latest update for Steam Frame adds up to 12%
articles.summary: Valve has pushed yet another update for SteamOS on the Steam Frame. It includes power efficiency improvements, eye tracking accessibility, and improved streaming reliability. Also something about grabbing handles?
body: It's the battery life improvements that most will feel the benefit of. A 12% improvement is pretty impressive for a single software update—the Steam Frame runs for around two hours while streaming, so you're looking at another 15 minutes or so from that bump alone. Though, as Valve notes, that's dependent on what you're playing and the power setting.
Valve also recently improved charging on the Steam Frame, allowing it to fast charge even when the headset is turned off. That dramatically decreases charging times in my testing.

SteamOS for Steam Frame is a whole new project for Valve. A version of its Arch-based Linux distro, used on the Steam Machine and Steam Deck, except built for virtual reality and Arm-based processors. Specifically, the Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 in the Frame, though laying the foundations for any further Arm-powered projects. I'd love to see an Arm-powered Steam Deck, though a recent rumour suggests the Steam Deck 2 will use another AMD chip instead.
points: Valve has pushed yet another update for SteamOS on the Steam Frame.

articles.title: I hate having to prove my brand loyalty just for the chance to buy hardware at full price
articles.summary: Nobody likes scalpers, man—it's already hard enough to get the latest and greatest hardware, let alone with some enterprising bad actor and their bots buying up all the available stock, and then charging an even greater fortune for sought-after bits of kit.
body: For instance, Sony Japan has rolled out an anti-scalper lottery system for PS5 Pro orders. To be in with even a chance of picking up the pricey console, you'll need a Sony account registered in Japan that has logged at least 60 hours or more of gaming, either on a PS4, a PS5, or both (via Tom's Hardware ). In theory, that should be enough of a faff to deter scalpers and an easy enough hurdle for PlayStation fans to overcome. In practice, I'm not loving the weird precedent of locking my potential hardware purchases behind a dystopian brand loyalty test.

To be fair to Valve, I did see reports of the Steam Machine being scalped for over $3,000. But 'In good standing'? What does that even mean? I couldn't find a precise definition from Valve itself; an account 'in good standing' could mean one not subject to a ban or any community restrictions, or it could mean an account that has made a purchase within a recent timeframe, or it could mean whatever suits Valve at any given moment. I'm still a little unclear on this finer point.

articles.title: PS5’s Exciting New Zelda-Like Kena Game Just Got Delayed
articles.summary: Developer Ember Lab has announced that its upcoming PS5 game Kena: Scars of Kosmora, the sequel to 2021's much-loved Kena: Bridge of Spirits, has been delayed. The game-- which gives off major Zelda vibes --was previously set to release this year, but now it's been delayed to 2027.
body: In a blog post, the developers said they need more time to "deliver a top-notch game that exceeds the quality" of Bridge of Spirits. "Pushing our release into 2027 gives us the ability to really polish the expanded game experience we want to deliver," the studio said.
Scars of Kosmora is a linear adventure game, just like the 2021 entry, but the sequel has a "broader and deeper scope," the studio said.

"We hope you’re just as excited to jump into Kena’s next adventure as we are to share it with you. We’ve been working hard to fill it with the wonder, charm, and challenge fans have come to expect," the team added. "We appreciate your patience and support as we take the time for Scars of Kosmora to be the evolution of Kena’s journey and experience we want to deliver."

In Scars of Kosmora, main character Kena is now a seasoned spirit guide and embarks on a journey to the island of Kosmora to find a "cure for her affliction and to reconnect with a friend from her past." The island holds a "powerful corruption" that fractures her staff, so Kena adopts a new method of manipulating the elements to her advantage.

articles.title: 'Digger' Ending Explained: A Spoiler-Filled Breakdown of Tom Cruise's Wild New Movie
articles.summary: Digger contains three big reveals that reshape our understanding of the movie in various ways. To really understand what Digger is about, you need to grapple with all three, and the way they fit together (both successfully and unsuccessfully) to tell a complex story about finding meaning at the end…
body: Digger is many things. It’s the first Tom Cruise movie in over a decade not to feature recognizable IP, fighter planes, or both. Its director Alejandro Iñárritu's biggest swing yet after divisive, high-brow films like Birdman and The Revenant. It’s a brutal condemnation of late-stage capitalism. It’s also a pretty clever magic trick.

The first big reveal comes about 30 minutes into Digger. After meeting the aging oil baron Rockwell Digger (Cruise), we quickly learn that his Greenland drilling operation has accidentally dislodged a massive hunk of ice into the Atlantic Ocean, and it’s heading straight for Northern Europe. The U.S. President (John Goodman) and his cabinet show up at Digger’s mansion to discuss their best options (there are none). Then, as Digger and President Compson step aside into a private room to discuss other matters, Iñárritu plays his first trick: The majestic tree outside slowly tips over in front of them… and then a giant hand reaches out from behind the horizon to grab it.
points: Digger contains three big reveals that reshape our understanding of the movie in various ways.
It’s the first Tom Cruise movie in over a decade not to feature recognizable IP, fighter planes, or both.

articles.title: GTA 6’s Weather System Sounds Like A Big Step Up
articles.summary: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 includes a number of updates and improvements over the developer's past games, and that includes new weather systems. Rockstar's vice president of art for lighting and rendering at Rockstar, Owen Shepherd, told Game Informer that the studio has "re-engineered" the…
body: He said the goal was to make the weather in GTA 6's setting of Leonida--a stand-in for Florida--feel "dynamically solid and achieve a sense of scale" that the studio has never done before.
What that means in practice is that GTA 6 will have "fully dynamic cloudscapes that roll across the map" to provide a "broad spectrum of weather" in the game.

Florida is known for its heat and humidity, along with its localized and fast-moving rain systems. Look one direction and you may see bright sunshine. Look the other and you could see a downpour. GTA 6 will replicate this with localized rain showers, along with rainbows that appear. Additionally, places where it recently rained in the game will remain wet, with puddles also popping up.

GTA 6 also has a new wind system that includes "offshore breezes after sunset, convectional updrafts, and occlusion from buildings,” Shepherd said. “Hair and debris will swirl around on rooftops; gusts of wind will blow ripples over the water surface and bend the grass in swamps.”

articles.title: Blizzard Isn’t Fixing Diablo 4 Season 15’s Biggest Bug
articles.summary: Diablo 4 Season 15's biggest bug, one revolving around Hellfire Torch and being able to equip more Unique charms than should be possible, won't be fixed this season, Blizzard has announced.
body: Hellfire Torch is a new Unique charm that counts as an extra set charm and comes with some great beneficial stats, like +All Skills, +All Stats, and +All Resistances. Players can usually only have one Unique charm equipped at a time, but Hellfire Torch breaks that rule, allowing players to use it and another Unique charm.

That's strong on its own, but there is currently a bugged interaction with Hellfire Torch that is allowing players to equip two Unique charms in addition to Hellfire Torch instead of one, granting even higher levels of power.

The bug seems to stem from Hellfire Torch being used first alongside the Seal of the Golden Epiphany, which allows players to equip up to three Unique charms. However, players are later swapping out Golden Epiphany for the Mythic Seal of the Diamond Mind, a seal that reduces the number of charms needed for set bonuses, but are still able to benefit from having additional Unique charms equipped. That, in turn, allows players to gain advantages from a full five-piece set bonus, Hellfire Torch, and two Unique charms all at once.
points: Diablo 4 Season 15's biggest bug, one revolving around Hellfire Torch and being able to equip more Unique charms than should be possible, won't be fixed this season, Blizzard has announced.

articles.title: PUBG extraction shooter Black Budget canned less than a year from reveal, after Krafton decide it won't "deliver an experience players could enjoy over the long term"
articles.summary: PUBG: Black Budget, an extraction shooter spin-off of Krafton's battle royale, has been cancelled after just under a year of closed alpha testing. Krafton cited a lack of faith that Black Budget's "current direction" would lead to "an experience players could enjoy over the long term" as the…
body: "After reviewing the project’s development status and future direction, we concluded that its current direction would not allow us to deliver an experience players could enjoy over the long term," the publishers wrote in a short development update post on Steam. "We have therefore made the difficult decision to end development of PUBG: Black Budget. We sincerely thank everyone who took the time to participate in our closed alpha tests and share their feedback.
"PUBG Studios will carry what we learned from development and testing into future projects, continuing to listen to players as we explore new gameplay experiences."

Black Budget was only revealed in November last year, and didn't even get a full release date prior to Krafton pulling out of it. The game was pitched as a "tactical extraction shooter" about mercenaries trying to recover top-secret tech from an abandoned research facility on an island trapped in a time loop. Cue lots of shooting while running from purple clouds that indicate the supernatural time threat, dubbed the Anomaly.
points: PUBG: Black Budget, an extraction shooter spin-off of Krafton's battle royale, has been cancelled after just under a year of closed alpha testing.

videos.summary: Don't miss the 'Instant Connection' Featurette for Klara and the Sun, a comedic sci-fi drama film distributed by Sony Pictures. Hear from Jenna Ortega on portraying an artificial friend in Klara and the Sun, in theaters on October 23.
body: Klara and the Sun introduces audiences to Klara (Jenna Ortega), an Artificial Friend who wants nothing more than to find the perfect home. When Klara meets Josie (Mia Tharia), each immediately senses a kindred spirit in the other. Josie has a fraught relationship with her mother (Amy Adams), and they’ve suffered great loss, but Klara’s innocent wonder and unwavering loyalty begin to heal the family and bring light to Josie’s complicated world.

Klara and the Sun stars Jenna Ortega, Amy Adams, Mia Tharia, Aran Murphy, Steve Buscemi, Natasha Lyonne, and more. The film is directed by Taika Waititi and executive produced by Gary Barber, Alex G. Scott, Jeffrey Clifford, Rosie Alison, and Kazuo Ishiguro.
